mediaDetails.ext_alt_text: Nine rendered configurations from certified stored poses, arranged in a three-by-three grid. Unit pieces are solid colored polyhedra; enclosing containers are muted wireframes. The labeled piece-to-container pairs are cubes/cube n=12, tetrahedra/tetrahedron n=12, octahedra/octahedron n=12, dodecahedra/dodecahedron n=33, icosahedra/icosahedron n=12, cubes/octahedron n=12, octahedra/cube n=12, dodecahedra/icosahedron n=12 and icosahedra/dodecahedron n=12. Headline: Polyhedra in polyhedra packing. The archive contains 351 certified constructions across nine ordered families, all counts 2–40. This is the frozen certified study archive, not a current-best leaderboard. A better externally reported octahedra-in-cube n=12 bound lacks retrieved poses. The cube n=12 specimen reproduces Yohei Nakajima’s construction.
